meta.title: Nexera for DSH
meta.description: Nexera is a growing DeepSeek Harness workspace plugin; version 1.0.0-beta ships its first feature, shared sticky notes. The sidebar gains a Sticky notes panel beside Plugins and Automation tasks: a wall of taped-up note cards, a full-page editor behind New note, and automatic saving to the Host. Every note carries an 'AI can read' switch: while it is on, the assistant sees that note in every following turn, and it can also create, read and update notes itself through the sticky_notes tool — so you can simply tell it to remember something and the note appears. Every browser page this DSH instance serves, including phone pages reached through the DSH mobile plugin, reads the same wall, so a second person who opens the page edits the very same notes; the Invite button in the panel header copies the link to send them. Notes live in $DSH_HOME/sticky-notes/notes.json on this machine and are never sent anywhere else. Turning the plugin off removes the sidebar row and the wall; the notes file stays until you delete it.
